reason: zod 3.25.x is pulled in only by @expo/cli, a build-time command line tool that is not part of the shipped app bundle. The flaw is memory exhaustion when validating oversized collections of untrusted input; the CLI only reads our own app.json. No patched 3.x exists and the fix (zod 4.6.6) needs an Expo major downgrade. Re-check when Expo ships a CLI built on zod 4.

picomatch is pulled in only by build and test tooling (Metro's file watcher, Jest, anymatch, micromatch), which match file patterns written by us, never user input; it is not part of the shipped app bundle. The flaw is a ReDoS on crafted extglob patterns. Every release up to the latest (4.0.7) is affected, so no fixed version exists yet. Remove this entry once a patched picomatch is released and the lockfile picks it up.
